---
title: "Explore"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
p_load(tidyverse, plotly)
```

@fig-explore is interactive: hover over a line to see its year, double-click a year in the
legend to show only that one. Data:
[@dwd2026](references.qmd#ref-dwd2026).

```{r}
#| label: fig-explore
#| fig-cap: "Monthly mean temperature in Karlsruhe, one line per year since 1990."
(read_csv("data/weather_karlsruhe.csv") |>
  filter(year(date) >= 1990) |>
  group_by(year = factor(year(date)), month) |>
  summarize(temp_mean = mean(temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = temp_mean, colour = year, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean temperature (°C)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()) |>
  ggplotly()
```

Compare this with the [yearly view](index.qmd#fig-anomaly) on the home page and the
[hot and frost days](days.qmd#fig-days).
